content.text: Now let me validate the redlines for the deviations.

input.summary: Add mutual uncapped carve-outs (Excluded Claims) to Sections 9 and 10 and disapply the data-loss exclusion for IBM-caused loss.
input.comment: [Playbook] The cap is mutual and based on 12 months' charges, but it swallows confidentiality/security breaches, gross negligence, wilful misconduct and fraud, and excludes all liability for loss of our data. We have added a standard Excluded Claims carve-out so indemnities, confidentiality/data-protection and wilful misconduct sit outside the cap.

ops.text: 9.3 Excluded Claims. Notwithstanding Sections 9.1, 9.2 and 10, the limitations and exclusions of liability in this Agreement do not apply to: (a) a party's breach of its confidentiality, data protection or security obligations; (b) a party's indemnification obligations; (c) a party's gross negligence, wilful misconduct or fraud; (d) a party's infringement of the other party's intellectual property rights; or (e) loss of, or damage to, Customer's records or data to the extent caused by IBM, its Affiliates or its Subcontractors. Customer's obligation to pay charges due under this Agreement is not subject to the limitations in Section 9.2.

input.summary: Narrow Customer's indemnity for Services Recipient claims to exclude claims caused by IBM.
input.comment: [Playbook] Section 8.2(a)(3) makes us indemnify IBM for any claim by a Services Recipient relating "directly or indirectly" to IBM's own Services; we cannot indemnify the Vendor for its own performance. We have carved out claims arising from IBM's acts, omissions or breach, leaving the rest of the indemnity intact.

ops.oldText: 3. that is brought by a Services Recipient and is related, directly or indirectly, to the Services; or
ops.newText: 3. that is brought by a Services Recipient and is related to the Services, except to the extent arising out of IBM's acts, omissions, negligence, wilful misconduct or breach of this Agreement; or
